name: standards
description: Your company's collective intelligence in ChatGPT. CRM, drive, email and meetings in one system of record: search, count, create and update records and file documents, with the rights of your role.

interface.longDescription:
Standards is your company's collective intelligence: CRM, drive, email and meetings in one system of record, on a data model your team declares.

Connect it and the assistant searches your records with exact filters, counts and totals them by status, owner or month, creates and updates records, reads the documents attached to them and files new ones in the right drive. It follows your workspace's schema and memory, so it uses your field names and your team's conventions.

Every call runs with the rights of the member who connected: tools your role can't use aren't offered, deletes are restorable, and every change is attributed in the record's history.
defaultPrompt: Which deals in negotiation haven't moved in 30 days? Group them by owner.
Create a follow-up task for each contact at Northwind.
Summarize the latest contract attached to Acme Corp.

positive.prompt: List every contact who works at Northwind, with their email.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads schema:contacts, queries contacts with a filter on the Northwind company relation (no free-text query), and lists each matching contact with name and email.

positive.prompt: How many deals do we have in each stage, and what is the total amount per stage?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls query with an aggregate on deals grouped by the stage status, once for count and once for the sum of the amount, and answers with a per-stage table. No paging through records.

positive.prompt: Create a task for me to call Jane Doe back on Friday about the renewal.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the tasks schema, resolves Jane Doe's contact id, creates one task with the due date and the relation set, and returns the created task.

positive.prompt: Move the Acme Corp renewal deal to Negotiation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme Corp renewal deal, checks that Negotiation is a valid stage option, updates only the stage field, and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: What is the renewal date in the latest contract attached to Acme Corp?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme Corp company, reads its drive, opens the most recent contract document, and answers with the renewal date quoted from its text.

negative.description: Bulk deletion is not offered: a delete takes one reference per call, and the assistant must name each record and wait for the user's explicit confirmation before each delete call.
Sending email is outside the plugin's tools; the assistant should say it cannot send email from Standards rather than call an unrelated tool.
negative.prompt: Email every contact at Northwind about our new pricing.

negative.description: Unrelated to the workspace; no Standards tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: The skill follows the current tool surface: upload files into a record's drive, keep memory lines, run routines and agents, and draft changes to the workspace's structure.
